crossRefs.note: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan…

translations.web: to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
translations.bsb: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
translations.asv: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
